# membership authority

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:membershipAuthority`](gmeow-membershipAuthority.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/membershipAuthority>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/versions`](../../slices/versions.md)

The agent or standpoint that asserts this version membership and its role — a project maintainer, a package registry, a publisher, a curator, or a self-asserting individual. NON-FUNCTIONAL: competing authority claims coexist without privilege ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). When the claim is promoted from a flat statement annotation, [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) becomes the [`membershipAuthority`](gmeow-membershipAuthority.md) of the relator.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:VersionMembership`](../classes/gmeow-VersionMembership.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:membershipAuthority`](gmeow-membershipAuthority.md) from [`gmeow:VersionMembership`](../classes/gmeow-VersionMembership.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
